messages:
zoe (PMM): starting thread for the benchmark-section of the launch. new anchor idea: an interactive 'budget slider' demo in the post + a live lab in the webinar where attendees can tweak payload and see latency vs cost iso-contours update. want a crisp hero chart + 2 CTAs: try the slider sandbox / sign up for lab.

pat (content): love it. headline thought: "Dial your SLA: what latency costs, in real numbers." sub: "Use our budget slider to match cost to user intent in seconds." will write a snappy intro that leads into the interactive.

kyle (product): product-side: the slider maps budget -> routing policy. default presets: developer (low-cost), product (balanced), enterprise (low-latency). the blog should show what each preset actually does (route mix, quantization level, cache policy). might be helpful to show the implicit cost formula we use.

mina (data): supplying seeded numbers. here's the dataset I'll publish with the article:
model,route,p50_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k,throughput
'stock','baseline',220,540,0.14,180
'eleven','fastpath',75,160,0.10,240
'quanta','quant+cache',45,90,0.035,120
Also will generate iso-cost lines for cost bands: $0.02, $0.05, $0.10 per 1k. I'll provide CSV + a small d3 snippet to draw contours.

ash (growth): inbound plan: forms need a field for "demo preference: slider sandbox / full lab" and hidden utm param slider_demo. route slider leads to automated sandbox email with explainer + quickstart; lab leads to calendar invite nurture. also propose a gated checklist for enterprises: "latency SLAs we care about" pdf.

pat (content): copy structure proposal: 1) one-sentence problem statement, 2) interactive hero with slider, 3) three scenario cards (dev/product/infra) showing numeric deltas, 4) mini FAQ about long prompts + quantization, 5) CTAs.

kyle (product): visual spec: hero = scatter + iso-contours + slider under chart. when you move slider lower, contours shift to show cheaper region and marker updates which route mix is used. micro-animations for route transitions. wireframe in Figma: https://figma.com/s/redwood-budget-slider (will invite).

mina (data): small chart pseudo-config for engineers (not a full spec):
```
// pseudo
x = latency_p50_ms; y = cost_per_1k; contours = isoCost(cost_matrix); points = models; slider -> setTargetCost(c)
```
I'll attach CSV to drive /marketing/assets/budget-slider.csv. note: p95 curves change with payload size; include a toggle for p50 vs p95.

benchbot: nightly-sim-99 finished. artifact: s3://redwood-bench/interactive/99/index.html   includes contour generation script and sample data.

ash (growth): for email subject lines A/B test: A) "How much latency will your users tolerate?" B) "Cut inference cost without breaking UX". also recommend a LinkedIn carousel showing 3 presets with numbers.

zoe (PMM): action items and owners: Pat -> draft hero + scenario microcopy. Mina -> deliver CSV + d3 snippet. Kyle -> wireframes + route presets doc. Ash -> forms + email copy + gated checklist. Benchbot/mina -> confirm artifacts linked to staging. deadline: assets ready for review in 36 hours. final sync tomorrow 9:30am PT. thanks all :sparkles:
